title: Severe Potholes and Waterlogging on MG Road Junction
description: Deep potholes spanning over 20 meters near the metro pillar 45. Multiple two-wheelers have skidded and traffic is backed up every evening.
responsibleDepartment: Municipal Corporation (MCD) / PWD Road Maintenance Cell
escalationPortal: Central Public Grievance Portal (CPGRAMS) & MCD 311 App
resolutionSteps: Complaint registered in MCD Central Grievance Database
Field Inspection by Junior Engineer completed on Oct 27
Bitumen patching tender assigned to zonal contractor

title: Overflowing Garbage Dump and Stray Cattle Nuisance
description: Garbage has not been collected from the community bin for 4 days. Foul smell and stray animals blocking the residential lane.
location: Block C, Sector 15 Market, Near Community Hall
responsibleDepartment: Solid Waste Management Dept, Municipal Corporation
resolutionSteps: Complaint assigned to Sanitary Inspector Ward 08
Compactor vehicle scheduled for immediate waste lifting
Sanitization and lime powder dusting to follow

title: Broken Streetlights Plunging Entire Street in Darkness
description: 5 consecutive streetlights have been non-functional for past 10 days, posing severe safety risk for women and pedestrians at night.
escalationPortal: DISCOM Online Complaint Portal & State Grievance Cell
resolutionSteps: Ticket generated with DISCOM Fault Repair team
Technician assigned for replacement of LED fixture and line check
